basis: The chart displays a clear, continuous upward trend in respiratory clinic visits from 2017 to 2020. The data points are explicitly positioned at approximately 130 (2017), 145 (2018), 158 (2019), and 171 (2020) on the 'Clinic visits (thousands)' axis. The chart's title and subtitle confirm it represents respiratory clinic visits for the 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary', which is limited to 2017-2020. The task requires a decision based on the end-to-end 2013-2020 utilization pattern, but no data for 2013-2016 is provided. Therefore, any claim of 'sustained growth' over the full 2013-2020 window is unsupported. The only verifiable trend is the recent upward shift from 2017 to 2020.
option_label: Route to continued monitoring for a recent upward shift in respiratory clinic visits
